newsitem.title: USA: Neurogen Corp stake held by Tisch group.
newsitem.headline: Neurogen Corp stake held by Tisch group.

text.p: Four Partners, a New York partnership controlled by the sons of Loews Corp co-chairman Laurence Tisch, said Monday it holds 771,900 shares or a 5.4 percent stake in Neurogen Corp.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, members of the group said they most recently purchased more than 200,000 shares of the Branford, Conn. drug company between March 6 and April 18 at $13.91 to $19.29 a share.
The group, which includes Andrew Tisch, Daniel Tisch, James Tisch and Thomas Tisch, said it holds the Neurogen shares for investment only.
